Earlier, MoveInSync had a very useful feature where employees could set their weekly off day in their profile. Based on this, when cab rosters were created for a long date range (like 1–2 months), the system would automatically exclude the selected week-off days. This saved time and avoided unnecessary bookings. Now this feature is missing, making rostering inconvenient and manual. I kindly request the team to bring back this helpful and user-friendly feature.
